correctness.rationale: Payoff differentiation gives the exact θ-threshold. The two-step forced affine update has infinity norm contraction c²<1, forcing a unique block-constant swapped opinion pair; the strict switching inequality simplifies exactly to p<p_*. This provides both necessity and sufficiency including the tie boundary. Strict margin and a two-step contraction establish full-state local exponential stability; consensus equilibria are also strict sinks. The exact four-player witness, symbolic payoff identity, branch algebra and rational eigenvalues were rechecked with CHECK.py.

value.rationale: The result identifies a sharp, model-specific social-influence boundary at which simultaneous public-goods best-response learning has an attracting temporal alternation that coexists robustly with both consensuses, even on fully positively weighted connected undirected graphs. This is a structurally motivated dynamical gap in equilibrium-centered studies, not an arbitrary finite numerical slice. The statement concerns every even population size and has an exact four-player witness, while making no unsupported global-classification claim.
